test_rolling_timeseries_window: test the TestRollingTS class that validates rolling window operations with time-based window strings on datetime-indexed DataFrames and Series
test_rolling_closed_parameter: test the closed parameter of DataFrame.rolling with time-based windows to verify right, left, both, and neither boundary behaviors
test_rolling_on_column: test the on parameter of DataFrame.rolling to specify a non-index column for time-based rolling window aggregation
test_rolling_ragged_time_series: test rolling window sum, mean, median, quantile, std, var, skew, kurt, count, min, max, first, last on DataFrames with irregularly spaced datetime indices
test_rolling_multi_index_level: test rolling window operations on a MultiIndex DataFrame using get_level_values to specify a date level for time-based rolling
